subject: The 3-minute routine that fixes volume
preview_text: Most people skip this step. It takes 180 seconds and changes everything.
body_paragraphs: There's a 3-minute window every morning where your audio is most forgiving. Right after you plug in your headphones, before the first podcast or song starts. Most people miss it.

That tiny pause is where volume breaks. You open an app, get distracted by an ad, and the slider ends up at 60% and you forget it exists. But if you take those 180 seconds to set your baseline — max boost, flat EQ, auto-apply — the rest of your day plays at the right level. No tweaking, no interruptions.

Volume Booster Pro remembers your last setting and applies it the second you connect headphones. Open the app once in the morning, set it to 200%, and let it sit. That's the routine. 3 minutes, and your audio feels consistent across every app — Spotify, YouTube, even games.

Open Volume Booster Pro now. Set your baseline. Then forget you ever had to adjust anything. P.S. — The one-time unlock turns this into a 'set it and never open it again' app. No subscriptions, no reminders.
